# PrettyMuch

> An AI creative pipeline for small businesses. One text prompt becomes images,
> video, music and copy — then publishes to up to 13 social platforms from a
> single button. Built in New Zealand, priced in NZD.

PrettyMuch is a web application (no install, no design software). A business
describes what it wants in a sentence; the platform generates six images to
choose from, then branches that chosen image into video, a music track,
AI-written captions, brand-applied compositions, and scheduled social posts.

## What it does

- **Images** — six options per prompt, or bring your own product photo and the
  generations are built around it.
- **Video** — 10, 15 or 30 second clips generated from a chosen image.
- **Music** — a track sized to the video length.
- **Copy** — platform-native captions and scripts.
- **Compositing** — cutout, inpaint, relight and blend as real layers, plus a
  brand kit (logo, colours, fonts) applied automatically.
- **Logo & brand** — generate a logo from a brief, refine it, export a vector
  brand package.
- **Publishing** — Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, YouTube,
  Pinterest, Google Business Profile and more, with scheduling and an approval
  workflow for teams.

## Pricing

Credit-based. 150 free credits on signup, no card required. Subscriptions from
NZD $29/month (Creator) through $79 (Business) to $249 (Agency). Credit top-up
packs from NZD $15. Full breakdown: https://prettymuch.nz/pricing

## Common questions

- **Do users own what they generate?** Yes — images, video, music and captions
  are the customer's to use commercially, stated in the terms.
- **Does anything post automatically?** No. Every asset and caption is reviewed
  and published by the user, or scheduled deliberately.
- **Are design skills needed?** No.
- **Where does data live?** Each customer's assets, brand kit and campaigns are
  isolated to their own workspace at the database level. Social accounts connect
  via OAuth; passwords are never seen by PrettyMuch.
